faq.q: Do I need any technology experience to take this course?
faq.a: No. No prior technology experience is required. The course is structured around doing rather than reading, so you work with the tools in real time and produce outputs for your own business as you go.

faq.q: Which AI tools does the course use?
faq.a: It works with AI language tools that are accessible and free to use, specifically ChatGPT and Claude, and also refers to Gemini. The focus is on instructing them effectively rather than on the tools themselves.

faq.q: What will I actually produce during the course?
faq.a: You are guided through prompts for a water damage scope of works, a mould remediation JSEA, an end-of-job client letter, an SOP for a specific cleaning task, a Google Business Profile description, and a social media post for a recent job.

faq.q: Can I rely on AI output for compliance documents?
faq.a: No. The course is explicit that AI tools produce confident-sounding content that may be factually incorrect, and that any document carrying professional, legal or compliance significance must be reviewed by a competent human before use. That review step is treated as non-negotiable.
